title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 41
description: Ten questions on Genesis 41: Pharaoh's dreams, Joseph's interpretation and his rise over the land of Egypt.

questions.text: At the end of how many full years did Pharaoh dream that he stood by the river?
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:1 says it was at the end of two full years that Pharaoh dreamed he stood by the river.

questions.text: Who told Pharaoh about the young Hebrew who had interpreted their dreams?
questions.explanation: The chief cup bearer remembered his faults and told Pharaoh about the young Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, who had interpreted their dreams.

questions.text: What did Joseph answer when Pharaoh said he had heard Joseph could interpret dreams?
questions.explanation: Joseph answered Pharaoh, "It isn't in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace."

answers.text: "It isn't in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace."
"Yes, I can interpret any dream you have."
"Let me first ask my father in Canaan."

questions.text: According to Joseph, what did the seven thin and ugly cattle stand for?
questions.explanation: Joseph said the seven thin and ugly cattle and the seven empty heads of grain were seven years of famine.

questions.text: What part of Egypt's produce did Joseph advise taking up in the seven plenteous years?
questions.explanation: Joseph advised Pharaoh to appoint overseers and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt's produce in the seven plenteous years.

questions.text: What did Pharaoh take off his own hand and put on Joseph's hand?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh took off his signet ring and put it on Joseph's hand, dressed him in fine linen and put a gold chain about his neck.

questions.text: What name did Pharaoh give to Joseph?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphenath-Paneah and gave him Asenath as a wife.

questions.text: How old was Joseph when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:46 says Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt.

questions.text: Why did Joseph name his firstborn son Manasseh?
questions.explanation: Joseph said, "God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house."

answers.text: God had made him forget all his toil and his father's house
God had made him fruitful in the land of his affliction
God had heard his cry while he was in the prison
God had given him a double portion of the land

questions.text: What did Pharaoh tell the Egyptians when they cried to him for bread?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do."

answers.text: "Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do."
